content.value: A majority gate is a digital circuit whose output is equal to 1 if the majority of the inputs are (09) $1 \mathbf { \dot { s } }$ The output is 0 otherwise. By means of a truth table, find the Boolean function, implemented by a 3-input majority gate. Simplify the function.
